source_description: Department of Computer Science and Engineering class-wise timetable, July 2026 - December 2026
notes: Schedule data is transcribed from the uploaded 11-page timetable.
Duplicate timetable subcolumns with identical content were deduplicated.
Class/section and default room are taken from each page heading; explicit lab/room text in individual cells overrides the default room.
Subject names and faculty names are resolved from the subject-master table on the same page where available; source cell text is preserved.
Where the timetable cell omits faculty information, the dataset does not invent a faculty member unless the same section master table provides a unique teacher for that coded subject.
This dataset is suitable as seed/import data for SchedNexa.
